cr_data.provenance:
By 1983, Doris Bry, New York. Private collection, Chicago. 1986, Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe. Private collection. Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe. 1993, sold by Beth Urdang Fine Art, Brookline, MA, to the MFA.  (Accession Date: February 24, 1993) 
(Source: MFA Boston, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Alternate title derives from O'Keeffe sales records. Dated 1916 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence and relationship to cat. nos. 112, 115. Completed in Virginia before August move to Texas. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: M. and M. Karolik Fund, The Hayden Collection—Charles Henry Hayden Fund, and the Painting Curator's Discretionary Fund
description: Abstract narrow forms with red, white, and black stripes sweep diagonally across the canvas like folds in a piece of draped, patterned fabric.
